question: 按分支统计 2015 年 12 月 31 日现金余额，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT db.Branch AS branch, SUM(fcb.Cash) AS cash_balance FROM atlas.dwd.fact_cash_balances fcb JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON fcb.SK_DateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_account da ON fcb.SK_AccountID = da.SK_AccountID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker db ON da.SK_BrokerID = db.SK_BrokerID WHERE dd.DateValue = DATE '2015-12-31' GROUP BY db.Branch ORDER BY cash_balance DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 现金余额是账户余额的一种
分支经账户托管关系归属
